propositions: Provider qualification is currently decided by a shape regex on the pre-colon prefix instead of checking membership in a known provider set, allowing typos and future model ID formats to be misclassified.
A typo'd configured provider (e.g., 'bedrok' instead of 'bedrock') passes config resolution and is only caught later at provider construction time instead of immediately during config resolution.

Five real provider names containing slashes (gateway/anthropic, gateway/bedrock, gateway/google-cloud, gateway/groq, gateway/openai) are incorrectly rejected by the current shape regex and must be accepted by membership-based decision.

The decision must distinguish between two contexts: inline model-string prefixes (which should fall back to unqualified if unrecognized, to preserve colon-bearing Bedrock IDs) and explicitly configured providers (which should fail fast with a clear error message).

Membership validation requires a static frozenset of exactly 24 provider names matching pydantic-ai's runtime registry to ensure the config layer remains stdlib-only and to catch provider additions upstream as test failures.
